Wherein though it be not po{{ls}}sible to {{ls}}et dovvne the preci{{ls}}e and vndoubted time or yere of euery thing, becau{{ls}}e neither S. Rom. 16, 15. Gal. 1.''}} Whereby the {{ls}}tudious reader may ea{{ls}}ily di{{ls}}couer the foly of the Prote{{ls}}tants, that can finde no time vvhen * Peter might po{{ls}}sibly come to Rome, be Bi{{ls}}hop, and die there: diuers things in S. Paules actes being no le{{ls}}{{ls}}e hard to reconcile to the cour{{ls}}e of S. Lukes narration, then any thing touching the hi{{ls}}torie of S. Peter, namely his * three yeres preaching in Arabia: al vvhich mu{{ls}}t needes be true, vvhether vve hit the very iu{{ls}}t time or no, and hovv {{ls}}o euer authors differ about the {{ls}}ame.
